objective: Correct warm agent turns per second
workUnit: One tool call and checked JSON answer using a growing near-131K-token archive session
cohortMeaning: Growing turns before forced GPU reset
Growing turns after LMCache resume; report the observed cache path, which need not become GPU-resident again
pressureInterpretation: Report KV preemptions and declined prefetch chunks alongside measured throughput. Bounded fallback is not automatically a correctness failure or a system OOM; all answers, external reuse and memory guards must still pass.
rejectedReferencePolicy: After two OCR gate failures, batch8192 may collect text-agent timing with an explicitly enabled, SHA-verified wrapper in the same frozen image. The original OCR failure remains recorded, remaining feature checks are marked unattempted, and the profile is excluded from recommendations. Experiment completion is distinct from profile qualification; other failures still stop the run.
selection: Compare both warm cohorts; require more than 5 percent gain in each cohort for a strong preference, otherwise retain the simpler qualified profile. Report latency and memory alongside throughput.
limitations: Fixed seed does not ensure bitwise GPU determinism.
The two warm cohorts can follow different cache paths; they are not necessarily repeated samples of an identical GPU-warm state.
Sequential profiles can be affected by thermal drift; this is a bounded screening and qualification protocol, not proof of a global optimum.
Synthetic checked turns do not measure general coding or agent task success.
